reference_sql:
SELECT month_start,
       CASE WHEN event IS NOT NULL THEN 'event'
            WHEN is_weekend THEN 'weekend'
            ELSE 'normal'
       END AS day_kind,
       COUNT(*) AS n_days
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY month_start, day_kind
alternatives: SELECT month_start, CASE WHEN event IS NOT NULL THEN 'event' WHEN weekday_name IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'normal' END AS day_kind, COUNT(*) AS n_days FROM calendar WHERE cal_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cal_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1, 2
